definitions.explanation: Completely white without any other color mixed in.
Having nothing written or recorded; empty of content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}だ。
examples.english: The whole area is pure white with snow.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{白|しろ}な⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{花嫁|はなよめ}→花嫁：04318_hanayome⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The bride in the pure white dress was beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}になった。
⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}になって、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}えなかった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My mind went blank from nervousness, and I couldn't say anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{答案|とうあん}→答案：03451_touan⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Time passed with the answer sheet still completely blank.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{真|ま}っ (emphatic prefix) + ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (white)
The っ intensifies the meaning.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - mind goes blank
- {真|ま}っ{白|しろ}な⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧ - complete lie, blatant lie
- {真|ま}っ{白|しろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{燃|も}え{尽|つ}きる - to burn out completely

- ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧ - bright red, blatant
